entities.name: Anowon
entities.description: An archaeomancer and scion of a powerful vampire family from Malakir on Zendikar, who searches relentlessly for the Eye of Ugin.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane where Anowon's vampire family lives and where he searches for the Eye of Ugin.

entities.name: Malakir
entities.description: The homeland of the vampires on Zendikar, from which Anowon comes.

entities.name: Akoum
entities.description: A region of Zendikar where Anowon had his base camp in the mountains.

entities.name: House Ghet
entities.description: The vampire house of which Anowon was the 'first son'.

entities.name: Tenihas
entities.description: The Bloodchief of House Ghet who was a father figure to Anowon and was murdered in his bedroom.

entities.name: Bala Ged Expeditionary House
entities.description: An expeditionary house to which Anowon briefly pledged loyalty.

entities.name: Dragon's Fire
entities.description: A powerful scroll Anowon acquired during an expedition.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: The city where Anowon infiltrated the Lighthouse community disguised as Kejahar.

entities.name: The Lighthouse
entities.description: A community of scholars in Sea Gate whose library is the largest collection of writings in Zendikar.

entities.name: Halimar
entities.description: The waters into which Anowon's broken body was cast from the seawall.

entities.name: Eye of Ugin
entities.description: A location linked to the secret past of the vampires that Anowon seeks.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A young planeswalker who asked Anowon for guidance to the Eye of Ugin and was almost killed by him.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A planeswalker who appeared and knocked Anowon out when he tried to kill Chandra.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind mage who pursued Chandra, disabled Anowon, read his mind, and persuaded him to lead the way to the Eye.

entities.name: Brood Lineage
entities.description: Eldrazi who, when released, enslaved Anowon like all other vampires they encounter.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A planeswalker who, with Nissa, freed Anowon from the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker who freed Anowon with Sorin, and whose actions led to the Release of the Eldrazi Titans.

entities.name: Release of the Eldrazi Titans
entities.description: The event, caused by Nissa's actions, that freed the Eldrazi Titans.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan who destroyed Bala Ged.

entities.name: Bala Ged
entities.description: A region of Zendikar destroyed by Ulamog.

entities.name: Kor Skyclaves
entities.description: A rising ancient Kor civilization whose secrets Anowon works to decipher.

entities.name: Ondu Skyclave
entities.description: A skyclave Anowon joined three adventurers to research.

entities.name: Grakmaw
entities.description: A hydra the adventurers and Anowon set out to eliminate.

events.summary: Bloodchief Tenihas is murdered in his bedroom; the only witness swears Anowon did it and vanished.
events.quote: The only surviving witness swore that Anowon had killed his bloodchief in a fit of rage and then vanished.

events.summary: Anowon acquires the Dragon's Fire scroll on an expedition, then renounces Bala Ged Expeditionary House and disappears.
events.quote: Anowon acquired a powerful scroll now known as the Dragon's Fire.

events.summary: Posing as Kejahar, Anowon infiltrates the scholars of the Lighthouse in Sea Gate and links the Eye of Ugin to the secret past of vampires.
events.quote: Anowon made a connection between the Eye of Ugin and the secret past of the vampires that Tenihas had so carefully protected.

events.summary: A kor woman who knew Anowon is found dead, and the militia uncover his vampire nature.
events.quote: they uncovered his hidden nature as a vampire.

events.summary: The enraged townspeople beat Anowon nearly to death and cast him into the Halimar, but he survives.
events.quote: They then cast his broken body over the seawall and into the waters of the Halimar far below.

events.summary: After Sea Gate, Anowon steals and kills indiscriminately in his hunt for the Eye of Ugin from his Akoum camp.
events.quote: From then on, he stole and killed indiscriminately to accomplish his goals.

events.summary: Chandra Nalaar appears in Anowon's camp asking for guidance, and he agrees once he learns she also seeks the Eye.
events.quote: One day, the young planeswalker Chandra Nalaar appeared in his camp, asking for Anowon's guidance.

events.summary: Anowon discovers Chandra has a physical map and tries to kill her; Sarkhan Vol knocks him out.
events.quote: He soon discovered that Nalaar actually possessed a physical map and so tried to kill her.

events.summary: Jace Beleren finds Anowon feeding off his guide, disables him, reads his mind, and persuades him to lead him to the Eye.
events.quote: Anowon attacked Jace, but the mind mage disabled him and read his mind

events.summary: The released Brood Lineage find Anowon near the Eye and enslave him for three months.
events.quote: they found Anowon near the Eye and enslaved him like all other vampires they encounter.

events.summary: Sorin Markov and Nissa Revane free Anowon, who accompanies them to the Eye of Ugin.
events.quote: until he was freed by Sorin Markov and Nissa Revane on the outskirts of Turntimber forest.

events.summary: Nissa's actions release the Eldrazi Titans and Anowon flees with the planeswalkers to Affa, where they part ways.
events.quote: they fled together to Affa where they parted ways.

events.summary: After Ulamog destroys Bala Ged, an unnamed Malakir vampire gives Nissa seeds of Zendikar's plants on Anowon's behalf.
events.quote: The vampire beseeched her to take the seeds and plant them on another plane.

events.summary: Anowon joins three adventurers to research the Ondu Skyclave and eliminate the Hydra Grakmaw.
events.quote: He found a new home with three adventurers whom he had joined to research the Ondu Skyclave and to eliminate the Hydra Grakmaw .

relations.quote: Anowon was "first son" of the House Ghet

relations.note: Anowon was under his tutelage and viewed him as a father figure.
relations.quote: Anowon viewed Tenihas as a father figure

relations.note: Alleged by the only surviving witness.
relations.quote: The only surviving witness swore that Anowon had killed his bloodchief in a fit of rage and then vanished.

relations.note: Pledged loyalty for a brief period.
relations.quote: He then pledged his loyalty to Bala Ged Expeditionary House for a brief period.

relations.note: Enslaved and obeyed their orders for three months.
relations.quote: For three months he obeyed the Eldrazi 's orders

relations.note: Freed him from the Eldrazi and travelled with him.
relations.quote: He then accompanied the two planeswalkers to the Eye of Ugin
After the destruction of Bala Ged by Ulamog

relations.note: Tried to kill her after finding she had a physical map.
